_comment: The thresholds this app holds itself to, in ONE place. Read by lib/design/catalogue/define.ts (the palette), lib/design/checks.ts (the canvas) and scripts/ui-fit-sweep.mjs (the real pages). They were three separate literals until 2026-08-23, which is how a studio ends up approving a mockup the live page would fail. JSON rather than TS so the .mjs sweep can read it too.
_minTapTarget: px. Apple says 44 and Google says 48; under 40 is a mis-tap, and a mis-tap on Delete is not cosmetic.
_minFontPx: Below this it stops being readable on a phone held at arm's length, whatever it looks like on a 27-inch monitor.
_minContrastBody: WCAG AA for text under 18.66px (or under 14px bold).
_minContrastLarge: WCAG AA for large text, and the floor for a control's own boundary.
_largeTextPx: 24px at normal weight is large; so is 18.66px bold. The bold case is handled in code.
